name: Flowchart
when: A process with steps, decisions and branches
exampleTitle: Order fulfilment from receipt to dispatch

name: Cross-Functional Flowchart
when: A process where who performs each step matters as much as the order
exampleTitle: Purchase approval across Requester, Finance and Procurement

name: BPMN Process
when: A process that must follow BPMN notation for a technical or compliance audience
exampleTitle: Claims intake as a BPMN collaboration

name: Organisation Chart
when: Reporting lines and roles in a team or organisation
exampleTitle: Engineering organisation after the Q1 reorganisation

name: Network Diagram
when: Servers, devices and the links between them
exampleTitle: Production network segments and their firewall boundaries

name: System Context Diagram
when: One system, the actors around it, and what flows between them
exampleTitle: Booking service and the systems it depends on

name: Block Diagram
when: Components and relationships where no formal notation applies
exampleTitle: Platform layers from ingestion to reporting

name: Fault Tree
when: How component failures combine into a top-level failure
exampleTitle: Causes of an unplanned production outage

name: Annotated Diagram
when: An existing diagram that needs callouts explaining what the reader should notice
exampleTitle: Current architecture with the three failure points marked
